title: RootSink: Reproducible C/C++ Crashes with Tested Repair Sites
abstract: arXiv:2611.23336v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a C or C++ program crashes on a crafted input, the line that crashes is often not the line that is wrong. Tools and models that repair or locate vulnerabilities need examples showing both, with evidence for each, which existing datasets rarely provide. RootSink provides 3341 records from 354 open-source projects. Most give the crash site a memory-error detector reported and a candidate location for its root cause, and label each with a weakness type and its evidence. For the 1954 records in the Reproduced tier, we re-ran the crash ourselves and confirmed that the fixed version runs cleanly. In 1275 of these, a single hunk of the developer's fix stopped the crash on its own. That marks a tested repair site, though not necessarily the defect, and 1273 records use it as the root. translated_title: RootSink：带经验证修复位置的可复现C/C++崩溃数据集
translated_abstract: 当C或C++程序在特制输入下崩溃时，崩溃发生的代码行往往并非真正出错的代码行。用于修复或定位漏洞的工具和模型需要同时展示崩溃位置与根因位置、并为二者提供证据的样本，而现有数据集很少能做到这一点。RootSink提供了来自354个开源项目的3341条记录，其中大多数记录包含内存错误检测器报告的崩溃位置、根因的候选位置，并为每个位置标注了弱点类型及其证据。对于“已复现”层级的1954条记录，研究团队自行重新运行了崩溃，并确认修复后的版本能够正常运行。其中1275条记录中，开发者修复补丁中的单个代码块即可独立阻止崩溃，这标记了一个经过测试验证的修复位置（尽管不一定是缺陷本身），其中1273条记录将其作为根位置。在对早期版本的一次盲审中，两位共同作者评审员将其见到的经测试修复位置中的68%和92%判定为缺陷本身，但仅有37%和51%的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RootSink数据集汇集了来自354个开源项目的3341条C/C++崩溃记录，通过实际复现崩溃并测试开发者修复补丁，为每条记录提供了带证据标注的崩溃位置与经过验证的修复位置，填补了漏洞定位与修复研究缺乏成对证据样本的空白。
en_tdlr: RootSink is a dataset of 3341 C/C++ crash records from 354 open-source projects, which reproduces crashes and tests developer fix hunks to pair evidence-labeled crash sites with tested repair sites for vulnerability localization and repair research.
